name: vombatus-ursinus
brief: Vombatus ursinus (Shaw, 1800) — Bare-Nosed / Common Wombat hypermedia species repository (South-Eastern Australia corridor). ECO-WP-07A covers ontological, fossorial osteology/myology, rump-shield & distal-colon biomechanics, joint ROM, InstanceState64 ontogeny, grazing ecology, and biocultural Country provenance; ECO-WP-07B will produce the 3-layer .vibe CAD and .hmc distribution.
